lessons.trigger_condition: persisted snapshot freshness regression compares historical fixture timestamps against wall-clock now
lessons.symptom_summary: a previously valid freshness fixture can become stale as real time advances even though production crosscheck logic is unchanged
lessons.fix_pattern: inject a fixed timezone-aware now into freshness regression tests while keeping the production 36-hour stale-evidence gate unchanged

lessons.trigger_condition: exchange_manifest learning_fields differs from the runtime PEER_LEARNING_FIELDS allowlist
lessons.symptom_summary: persisted and runtime peer-learning snapshots can disagree about allowed fields despite each component passing isolated tests
lessons.fix_pattern: centralize the 13 learning fields in shared contracts, make runtime normalization consume that contract, and regression-lock the manifest to it

lessons.trigger_condition: a root-level regression test imports instagram_tcg_content directly
lessons.symptom_summary: domain boundary guard blocks Main and 06:00 workflows before functional tests run
lessons.fix_pattern: place Instagram-specific regression tests inside instagram_tcg_content and avoid adding broad control-plane exceptions

lessons.trigger_condition: persisted JSON is written with sorted keys and readback validation compares dict iteration order to canonical field order
lessons.symptom_summary: all required learning fields are present but self-test fails because serialization reordered JSON object keys
lessons.fix_pattern: validate canonical projection order before serialization and validate the exact field set after JSON readback
